explication: Open Food Network is a multi-store marketplace connecting local food producers and hubs with buyers. The principal customer journey is discovering a shop and its products, adding items to a cart, and checking out through a payment option. The repository also has distinct enterprise administration, APIs, reporting, and connected-app/webhook capabilities. The tree and sampled routes support the customer and payment entry points; unsampled subsystems are included where their paths identify meaningful product areas, without asserting unverified call relationships.
